en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival opens Friday at Victoria Park
en.dek: The Chiu Chow clansmen’s association stages three free days at Soccer Pitch 1 from 10am to 9pm, with ghost-grabbing contests on Saturday and Sunday.
body: The 2026 Yu Lan Cultural Festival opens on Friday at Soccer Pitch 1 in Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, running through Sunday, the Hong Kong Tourism Board and the organisers said.

The Hong Kong Chiu Chow Clansmen’s Association is presenting the ninth edition under the theme Merit Made Visible. Admission is free. Hours are 10am to 9pm each day. The Tourism Board listing names an enquiry number of 2559 2181. Causeway Bay MTR Exit E is the nearest station.

The programme listed by the organisers includes a history exhibition, guided tours and workshops, the immersive theatre piece Crossing the Sea, Crossing People, and the final stop of a circulating “merit passbook” photo activity. A ghost-grabbing contest for tertiary teams and a stacked-offering contest are scheduled for Saturday, with an open ghost-grabbing contest on Sunday.

Chiu Chow Yu Lan gatherings are a national-level intangible cultural heritage practice that took root in Hong Kong with migrants from the region. The organisers said at an August briefing that they expected attendance similar to last year’s, about 40,000 visits over the three days.

zh.headline: 皿蘭文化節周五起在維園舉行 免費入場至周日
zh.dek: 香港潮屬社團總會周五至周日於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號足球場舉辦第九屆皿蘭文化節，上午10時至晚上9時，設搶孤及盆供比賽。
body: 香港旅遊發展局及主辦單位表示，2026皿蘭文化節周五起至周日在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號足球場舉行。
活動由香港潮屬社團總會主辦，為第九屆，主題為「功德顯影」，免費入場，每日上午10時至晚上9時。旅發局資料列出查詢電話2559 2181，鄰近港鐵銅鑼灣站E出口。
主辦單位公布的節目包括皿蘭文化歷史展覽、導賞及工作坊、實境互動劇場《渡海·渡人》，以及「功德+1」巡迴打卡最終站。周六舉行搶孤競賽院校賽及盆供堆疊賽，周日舉行搶孤競賽公開賽。
潮人皿蘭勝會屬國家級非物質文化遺產，自上世紀隨潮汕人士移居本港而扎根各區。主辦方於8月記者會表示，預料三日入場約4萬人次，與去年相若。
